name: Chart/Multi-Line-Chart
description:
Multi-line chart: the line chart (Border/Accent/Solid line over the Accent area, sector rules, Tooltip, X labels) with one dashed comparison series (Border/Neutral/Solid at 40%, dash 4/5, round caps) and its active dot, a legend (.Chart/Legend-Item) above the plot and one Tooltip with both values.


Sector: 4, 6, 7 or 12 X values. Pick the one that matches your data: the comparison overlay (Compare-Grid) is laid out for that count and cannot be re-gridded in an instance, so switch this property, never only the nested Trend's Sector.


Use it for a value against a reference over time (this team vs company average, this year vs last). One series: Chart/Line-Chart. Parts of a total: Chart/Stack-Bar-Chart.


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
